text: The Titanic's watertight walls didn't go all the way up.
Its hull was split into sixteen compartments, and it could float with the first four flooded.
As the bow sank lower, water spilled over the top of each wall into the next one, like an ice cube tray.
From then on, nothing could save her. Two hours and forty minutes after the collision, she was gone.
So, could a head-on hit have saved her? Full video on my channel.
